notes: V108: Haigen's persistent local mind simulation evolves curiosity, courage, trust, choices, plans and notes. Mailbox replaced by his own notebook; old player notes preserved in its archive. The Quiet Hands story gradually reveals two unseen world-builders alongside the Silent Pond quest. No flowers on the beach or around campfires. Opt-in ambience now includes quieter, proximity-gated wildlife and wood chopping, pickaxe ping, digging, tool swoosh and encounter sounds. Original Ember, quests and old saves preserved.
